aawc_reforging_round_single_flow_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_last_applied value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_last_unserved value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_input_valid value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_checked_value value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = $CARRY$ } add = var:$CARRY$ } } }
	if = { limit = { aawc_reforging_round_checked_value_value < 0 } set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_input_valid value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { aawc_reforging_round_input_valid_value = 1  }
		set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_single_due value = { value = $AMOUNT$ min = 0 add = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = $CARRY$ } add = var:$CARRY$ } } } }
		set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_single_whole value = { value = aawc_reforging_round_single_due_value floor = yes } }
		set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_last_applied value = { value = aawc_reforging_round_single_whole_value max = $CAPACITY$ min = 0 floor = yes } }
		set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_last_unserved value = { value = aawc_reforging_round_single_whole_value subtract = aawc_reforging_round_last_applied_value } }
		set_variable = { name = $CARRY$ value = { value = aawc_reforging_round_single_due_value subtract = aawc_reforging_round_single_whole_value } }
		set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_rejected_whole_total value = { value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_reforging_round_rejected_whole_total } add = var:aawc_reforging_round_rejected_whole_total } } add = aawc_reforging_round_last_unserved_value } }
		remove_variable = aawc_reforging_round_single_due
		remove_variable = aawc_reforging_round_single_whole
	}
	else = { set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_invalid_rejections_total value = { value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_reforging_round_invalid_rejections_total } add = var:aawc_reforging_round_invalid_rejections_total } } add = 1 } } }
	remove_variable = aawc_reforging_round_checked_value
	remove_variable = aawc_reforging_round_checked_whole
	remove_variable = aawc_reforging_round_input_valid
}

aawc_reforging_round_compat_mortality_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_input_valid value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_checked_value value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = $BAND$ } add = var:$BAND$ } } }
	set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_checked_whole value = { value = aawc_reforging_round_checked_value_value floor = yes } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { aawc_reforging_round_checked_value_value < 0 aawc_reforging_round_checked_value_value != aawc_reforging_round_checked_whole_value } } set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_input_valid value = 0 } }
	set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_checked_value value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = $FRACTION$ } add = var:$FRACTION$ } } }
	if = { limit = { aawc_reforging_round_checked_value_value < 0 } set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_input_valid value = 0 } }
	set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_checked_value value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = $FRACTION$_backlog } add = var:$FRACTION$_backlog } } }
	if = { limit = { aawc_reforging_round_checked_value_value < 0 } set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_input_valid value = 0 } }
	set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_checked_value value = $RATE$ }
	if = { limit = { aawc_reforging_round_checked_value_value < 0 } set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_input_valid value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { aawc_reforging_round_input_valid_value = 1  }
		set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_compat_due value = { value = $RATE$ add = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = $FRACTION$ } add = var:$FRACTION$ } } add = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = $FRACTION$_backlog } add = var:$FRACTION$_backlog } } } }
		set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_compat_applied value = { value = aawc_reforging_round_compat_due_value floor = yes max = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = $BAND$ } add = var:$BAND$ } } min = 0 } }
		set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_compat_left value = { value = aawc_reforging_round_compat_due_value subtract = aawc_reforging_round_compat_applied_value } }
		set_variable = { name = $FRACTION$_backlog value = { value = aawc_reforging_round_compat_left_value floor = yes } }
		set_variable = { name = $FRACTION$ value = { value = aawc_reforging_round_compat_left_value subtract = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = $FRACTION$_backlog } add = var:$FRACTION$_backlog } } } }
		set_variable = { name = $BAND$ value = { value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = $BAND$ } add = var:$BAND$ } } add = { value = aawc_reforging_round_compat_applied_value multiply = -1 } } }
		set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_cohort_last_deaths value = { value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_reforging_cohort_last_deaths } add = var:aawc_reforging_cohort_last_deaths } } add = aawc_reforging_round_compat_applied_value } }
	}
	else = { set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_invalid_rejections_total value = { value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_reforging_round_invalid_rejections_total } add = var:aawc_reforging_round_invalid_rejections_total } } add = 1 } } }
	remove_variable = aawc_reforging_round_checked_value
	remove_variable = aawc_reforging_round_checked_whole
	remove_variable = aawc_reforging_round_input_valid
	remove_variable = aawc_reforging_round_compat_due
	remove_variable = aawc_reforging_round_compat_applied
	remove_variable = aawc_reforging_round_compat_left
}

aawc_reforging_round_compat_aging_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_cohort_work_aged value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_input_valid value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_checked_value value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = $SOURCE$ } add = var:$SOURCE$ } } }
	set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_checked_whole value = { value = aawc_reforging_round_checked_value_value floor = yes } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { aawc_reforging_round_checked_value_value < 0 aawc_reforging_round_checked_value_value != aawc_reforging_round_checked_whole_value } } set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_input_valid value = 0 } }
	set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_checked_value value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = $DESTINATION$ } add = var:$DESTINATION$ } } }
	set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_checked_whole value = { value = aawc_reforging_round_checked_value_value floor = yes } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { aawc_reforging_round_checked_value_value < 0 aawc_reforging_round_checked_value_value != aawc_reforging_round_checked_whole_value } } set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_input_valid value = 0 } }
	set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_checked_value value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = $FRACTION$ } add = var:$FRACTION$ } } }
	if = { limit = { aawc_reforging_round_checked_value_value < 0 } set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_input_valid value = 0 } }
	set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_checked_value value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = $FRACTION$_backlog } add = var:$FRACTION$_backlog } } }
	if = { limit = { aawc_reforging_round_checked_value_value < 0 } set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_input_valid value = 0 } }
	set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_checked_value value = { value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = $SOURCE$ } add = var:$SOURCE$ } } divide = 60 } }
	if = { limit = { aawc_reforging_round_checked_value_value < 0 } set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_input_valid value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { aawc_reforging_round_input_valid_value = 1  }
		set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_compat_due value = { value = { value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = $SOURCE$ } add = var:$SOURCE$ } } divide = 60 } add = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = $FRACTION$ } add = var:$FRACTION$ } } add = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = $FRACTION$_backlog } add = var:$FRACTION$_backlog } } } }
		set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_compat_applied value = { value = aawc_reforging_round_compat_due_value floor = yes max = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = $SOURCE$ } add = var:$SOURCE$ } } min = 0 } }
		set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_compat_left value = { value = aawc_reforging_round_compat_due_value subtract = aawc_reforging_round_compat_applied_value } }
		set_variable = { name = $FRACTION$_backlog value = { value = aawc_reforging_round_compat_left_value floor = yes } }
		set_variable = { name = $FRACTION$ value = { value = aawc_reforging_round_compat_left_value subtract = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = $FRACTION$_backlog } add = var:$FRACTION$_backlog } } } }
		set_variable = { name = $SOURCE$ value = { value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = $SOURCE$ } add = var:$SOURCE$ } } add = { value = aawc_reforging_round_compat_applied_value multiply = -1 } } }
		set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_cohort_last_aged value = { value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_reforging_cohort_last_aged } add = var:aawc_reforging_cohort_last_aged } } add = aawc_reforging_round_compat_applied_value } }
		set_variable = { name = $DESTINATION$ value = { value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = $DESTINATION$ } add = var:$DESTINATION$ } } add = aawc_reforging_round_compat_applied_value } }
		set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_cohort_work_aged value = aawc_reforging_round_compat_applied_value }
	}
	else = { set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_invalid_rejections_total value = { value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_reforging_round_invalid_rejections_total } add = var:aawc_reforging_round_invalid_rejections_total } } add = 1 } } }
	remove_variable = aawc_reforging_round_checked_value
	remove_variable = aawc_reforging_round_checked_whole
	remove_variable = aawc_reforging_round_input_valid
	remove_variable = aawc_reforging_round_compat_due
	remove_variable = aawc_reforging_round_compat_applied
	remove_variable = aawc_reforging_round_compat_left
}

aawc_reforging_round_compat_military_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_input_valid value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_checked_value value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = $SOURCE$ } add = var:$SOURCE$ } } }
	set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_checked_whole value = { value = aawc_reforging_round_checked_value_value floor = yes } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { aawc_reforging_round_checked_value_value < 0 aawc_reforging_round_checked_value_value != aawc_reforging_round_checked_whole_value } } set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_input_valid value = 0 } }
	set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_checked_value value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = $DESTINATION$ } add = var:$DESTINATION$ } } }
	set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_checked_whole value = { value = aawc_reforging_round_checked_value_value floor = yes } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { aawc_reforging_round_checked_value_value < 0 aawc_reforging_round_checked_value_value != aawc_reforging_round_checked_whole_value } } set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_input_valid value = 0 } }
	set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_checked_value value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = $PARENT_SOURCE$ } add = var:$PARENT_SOURCE$ } } }
	set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_checked_whole value = { value = aawc_reforging_round_checked_value_value floor = yes } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { aawc_reforging_round_checked_value_value < 0 aawc_reforging_round_checked_value_value != aawc_reforging_round_checked_whole_value } } set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_input_valid value = 0 } }
	set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_checked_value value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_reforging_cohort_work_aged } add = var:aawc_reforging_cohort_work_aged } } }
	set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_checked_whole value = { value = aawc_reforging_round_checked_value_value floor = yes } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { aawc_reforging_round_checked_value_value < 0 aawc_reforging_round_checked_value_value != aawc_reforging_round_checked_whole_value } } set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_input_valid value = 0 } }
	set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_checked_value value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = $FRACTION$ } add = var:$FRACTION$ } } }
	if = { limit = { aawc_reforging_round_checked_value_value < 0 } set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_input_valid value = 0 } }
	set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_checked_value value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = $FRACTION$_backlog } add = var:$FRACTION$_backlog } } }
	if = { limit = { aawc_reforging_round_checked_value_value < 0 } set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_input_valid value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { aawc_reforging_round_input_valid_value = 1  }
		set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_compat_before value = { value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = $PARENT_SOURCE$ } add = var:$PARENT_SOURCE$ } } add = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_reforging_cohort_work_aged } add = var:aawc_reforging_cohort_work_aged } } } }
		set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_compat_due value = { value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = $FRACTION$ } add = var:$FRACTION$ } } add = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = $FRACTION$_backlog } add = var:$FRACTION$_backlog } } } }
		if = { limit = { aawc_reforging_round_compat_before_value > 0 } set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_compat_due value = { value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_reforging_round_compat_due } add = var:aawc_reforging_round_compat_due } } add = { value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_reforging_cohort_work_aged } add = var:aawc_reforging_cohort_work_aged } } multiply = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = $SOURCE$ } add = var:$SOURCE$ } } divide = aawc_reforging_round_compat_before_value } } } }
		set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_compat_applied value = { value = aawc_reforging_round_compat_due_value floor = yes min = { value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = $SOURCE$ } add = var:$SOURCE$ } } subtract = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = $PARENT_SOURCE$ } add = var:$PARENT_SOURCE$ } } min = 0 } max = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = $SOURCE$ } add = var:$SOURCE$ } } max = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_reforging_cohort_work_aged } add = var:aawc_reforging_cohort_work_aged } } } }
		set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_compat_left value = { value = aawc_reforging_round_compat_due_value subtract = aawc_reforging_round_compat_applied_value min = 0 } }
		set_variable = { name = $FRACTION$_backlog value = { value = aawc_reforging_round_compat_left_value floor = yes } }
		set_variable = { name = $FRACTION$ value = { value = aawc_reforging_round_compat_left_value subtract = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = $FRACTION$_backlog } add = var:$FRACTION$_backlog } } } }
		set_variable = { name = $SOURCE$ value = { value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = $SOURCE$ } add = var:$SOURCE$ } } add = { value = aawc_reforging_round_compat_applied_value multiply = -1 } } }
		$DESTINATION_ACTION$ = { AMOUNT = aawc_reforging_round_compat_applied_value DESTINATION = $DESTINATION$ }
	}
	else = { set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_invalid_rejections_total value = { value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_reforging_round_invalid_rejections_total } add = var:aawc_reforging_round_invalid_rejections_total } } add = 1 } } }
	remove_variable = aawc_reforging_round_checked_value
	remove_variable = aawc_reforging_round_checked_whole
	remove_variable = aawc_reforging_round_input_valid
	remove_variable = aawc_reforging_round_compat_before
	remove_variable = aawc_reforging_round_compat_due
	remove_variable = aawc_reforging_round_compat_applied
	remove_variable = aawc_reforging_round_compat_left
	remove_variable = aawc_reforging_cohort_work_aged
}

aawc_reforging_round_credit_band_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_last_applied value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { aawc_reforging_round_counts_valid_value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_single_capacity value = { value = $AMOUNT$ min = 0 add = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = $BAND$_credit_pending } add = var:$BAND$_credit_pending } } floor = yes } }
		aawc_reforging_round_single_flow_effect = { AMOUNT = $AMOUNT$ CARRY = $BAND$_credit_pending CAPACITY = aawc_reforging_round_single_capacity_value }
		remove_variable = aawc_reforging_round_single_capacity
		set_variable = { name = $BAND$ value = { value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = $BAND$ } add = var:$BAND$ } } add = aawc_reforging_round_last_applied_value } }
		aawc_reforging_cohort_reconcile_effect = yes
		aawc_reforging_cohort_refresh_mirrors_effect = yes
	}
	else = { set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_round_invalid_rejections_total value = { value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_reforging_round_invalid_rejections_total } add = var:aawc_reforging_round_invalid_rejections_total } } add = 1 } } }
}
